subject: Mid-cycle token surge, multi-entity apportionment and VAT split — clarification request
messages:
From: Oliver Park <oliver@glacial.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: billing@glacial.ai
Date: Tue, 09 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mid-cycle token surge — apportionment and VAT split

Hi Karthik / Ben,

We pulled this month's invoice and noticed a ~3.2x token surge between Jun 1–8 compared to the baseline we both agreed on in the SOW. The invoice (attached) assigned all usage to Glacial AI (US entity) which pushes VAT liability into the US entity for the full amount.

Two important things:
- Glacial operates under two legal entities for production traffic (Glacial US and Glacial EU). Our embed ingestion for EU customers should have been tagged to the EU entity; it appears to have been attributed to the US node.
- If that attribution is incorrect, we need a corrected VAT split and a credit for the over-attributed tokens (US -> EU reclassification). This is material to our month-end close.

I attached a small CSV sample (usage_sample_Jun01-Jun08.csv) and the invoice (invoice_20260601.pdf). Can you confirm receipt and share the logs/trace that show tenant_entity or org_id used for attribution? Also, approximate ETA for a corrected invoice or provisional credit?

We're happy to hop on a short call if that helps.

Thanks,
Oliver Park
Head of Infrastructure — Glacial AI
oliver@glacial.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>

Subject: RE: Mid-cycle token surge — apportionment and VAT split

Ben / Marissa — looping you in.

Quick read: external shows a large mid-cycle jump. Initial hunch: tenant tagging drift or ingestion pipeline routing defaulted to the US-entity pool during a short re-deploy window on Jun 2. If that's true we need to:
1) Extract per-request attribution for Jun 1–8 (tenant_entity, org_id, request_id).
2) Validate whether any model-variant fallback (quantized fallback) changed route policies that could cause reclassification.
3) Prepare a provisional credit for the EU-apportioned tokens while we investigate (Glacial will need ETA for finance teams).

Ben — can you pull the per-request attribution logs and the routing decision records for the 2026-06-02 00:00 — 2026-06-03 08:00 UTC window? Marissa — please prepare a short note for Ops/Billing describing the reclassification scenario and the credit guardrail we can offer while we confirm.

I'll respond to Oliver after we have the first set of logs.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
